notes: Table-based listing layout. Each listing has two rows: one with ID starting with 'L' contains main data, and one with ID starting with 'D' contains description. The raw_text field contains both title and location concatenated - location appears after the title following a line break. Descriptions are in following sibling tr[id^='D']. Numeric values may need cleaning (commas, etc.). Detail page URLs are relative and need to be prefixed with domain.
